result.stderr:
ContextOS cannot start: no functional embeddings provider.

The configured provider is: onnx
Detail: ONNX model files (all-MiniLM-L6-v2.onnx + vocab.txt) not found in any of:
  /tmp/inspectra-help-contex-33bcc8d1-4a14ce05/tool/.store/contextos/0.1.4/contextos/0.1.4/tools/net10.0/any/Models
  /tmp/inspectra-help-contex-33bcc8d1-4a14ce05/tool/.store/contextos/0.1.4/contextos/ContextOS.Embeddings/Models

The ONNX model is not bundled in the .NET tool package.

Options:
  1. Download the model manually:
       mkdir -p ~/.contextos/models
       curl -L -o ~/.contextos/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.onnx \
         https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx
       curl -L -o ~/.contextos/models/vocab.txt \
         https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/resolve/main/vocab.txt
     Then add to ~/.contextos/config.json:
       {"embeddings":{"modelsDir":"~/.contextos/models"}}

  2. Use Ollama instead (no model download needed):
       Install Ollama, then: ollama pull nomic-embed-text
     Then add to ~/.contextos/config.json:
       {"embeddings":{"provider":"ollama"}}

  3. Use the platform binary (includes the model):
       https://github.com/aftabkh4n/contextos/releases/latest

To fix:
  - For the default ONNX provider:
      The model is not bundled in the .NET tool package. Options:
      a) Download manually and point to it in config:
           mkdir -p ~/.contextos/models
           curl -L -o ~/.contextos/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.onnx \
             https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx
           curl -L -o ~/.contextos/models/vocab.txt \
             https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/resolve/main/vocab.txt
         Then add to ~/.contextos/config.json:
           {"embeddings":{"modelsDir":"~/.contextos/models"}}
      b) Switch to Ollama: ollama pull nomic-embed-text
         Then add to ~/.contextos/config.json:
           {"embeddings":{"provider":"ollama"}}
  
[truncated]
